text: God glorifies - Blessed and Most High
I ask forgiveness from God, I ask forgiveness from God, I ask forgiveness from God, O God, You are peace, and from You is peace. Blessed are you, O Possessor of glory and honor.

There is no god but God, He alone has no partner, to Him belongs the dominion, to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things. There is no power nor power except in God. There is no god but God, and we worship none but Him. To Him belongs the blessing, and to Him is the bounty, and to Him is the good praise. There is no god but God, sincere in religion to Him, even if the disbelievers hate it.
He recites: “Say: He is God, One” [Al-Ikhlas: 1], and “Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of Al-Falaq” [Al-Falaq: 1], and “Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind” [Al-Nas: 1]

There is no god but God, He alone has no partner, to Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things. Oh God, there is no one who can prevent what you have given, and there is no giver of what you withhold, and no one who is serious will benefit from you.
Glory be to God, praise be to God, God is great (thirty-three), there is no god but God alone, with no partner, to Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things.
